title.zh: US 20-year bond auction just had its worst showing ever
title.en: US 20-year bond auction just had its worst showing ever

current_state.zh: The US Treasury's 20-year bond auction saw the highest yield-to-maturity since 1986 at 5.42% and the lowest-ever share of foreign buyers, signaling record borrowing costs and weakening overseas demand for US sovereign debt.
current_state.en: The US Treasury's 20-year bond auction saw the highest yield-to-maturity since 1986 at 5.42% and the lowest-ever share of foreign buyers, signaling record borrowing costs and weakening overseas demand for US sovereign debt.
